title: Security: replay of signed URLs
spec: Add test/security/replay.test.ts proving the properties the venue relies on: a signed say-signed url for (room, nonce, text) does not verify for another room, another nonce or a swept-different text; a captured signature cannot be re-used with a different DID; and VenueClient never signs a text longer than the cap. Add any missing guard in src/identity or src/venue you find, as a separate commit in the same patch.
done: The replay properties hold and any guard added is covered.
